name: Ridicule
overview: Scripture reveals that ridicule often accompanies trials faced by the godly, as seen when Samson was mocked while imprisoned (Judges 16:25) and Jesus was laughed to scorn (Mark 5:40). The psalmist expresses trust in God’s deliverance from those who persecute and mock (Psalms 7:1; 34:17), encouraging believers to bless the Lord continually despite opposition (Psalms 34:1). Additionally, Proverbs reminds us not to despise the Lord’s correction, which may come through hardship, including ridicule (Proverbs 3:11). These verses collectively teach that while ridicule can be painful, God hears the cries of the righteous and sustains them through such trials.
